1579.title: Lake Tahoe telephone cables, removed
1579.summary: CSLC lease PRC 1579 began November 14, 1955 for submarine telephone and telegraph cables on the bed of Lake Tahoe between Rubicon Bay and Baldwin Beach. On February 28, 2023 (Staff Report 29), Commission staff recommended amending the lease to authorize the lessee to remove the facilities in their entirety, including severed segments and debris, and restore the lease area so the lease could be terminated. The staff report notes a November 2021 federal consent decree between the lessee and the California Sportfishing Protection Alliance and concerns about lead leaching from the cable. The cable is fully removed: it came out of the lake in November 2024, and the final shore section at Baldwin Beach and Tallac Creek was removed on September 17, 2025.
1579.layerCaveat: The public GIS layer still lists this lease with RecordStatus "Active". RecordStatus does not show whether the facilities are still there.
